item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “Switched off phone, social media,” Sanju Samson opens up on dealing with lean patch after Kolkata heroics
item.description: Sanju Samson stole the show in India’s five-wicket victory over the West Indies in a must-win Super 8 clash of the T20 World Cup 2026 at Eden Gardens, Kolkata on Sunday (March 1). The wicketkeeper-batter slammed 97 not out off 50 balls with 12 fours and 4 sixes to help India chase down a stiff target of 196 runs with four deliveries to spare. item.title: “I wouldn't even keep him in the team,” Shahid Afridi’s scathing verdict on Shadab Khan amid captaincy debate
item.description: Pakistan were knocked out of the T20 World Cup 2026 following the Super 8 stage, missing out on the semifinals of an ICC men's event for the fourth successive time. The Men in Green began their campaign on a nervy note, almost suffering a loss against the Netherlands. The team then defeated the USA but were crushed by arch-rivals India. item.title: “Trying to keep my family safe”- Jonny Bairstow reveals he's with his family in Dubai and not with England Lions
item.description: England cricketer Jonny Bairstow has revealed that he is not with the England Lions squad, but instead, he is stuck in Dubai with his young family and fears for their safety. This comes amidst escalating military tensions in the Middle East. item.description: The escalating conflict between the USA, Israel, and Iran has led to widespread Middle East airspace closures. item.title: ICC releases list of match officials for T20 World 2026 semifinals
item.description: The International Cricket Council (ICC) on Tuesday (March 3) announced the match officials for the semifinals of the Men’s T20 World Cup 2026. While South Africa and New Zealand will square off in the first semifinal at the Eden Gardens in Kolkata on March 4, India will take on England in the second semifinal in Mumbai’s Wankhede Stadium.
